mapper.select: select result_id, assessment_id, mode, cast(engine_versions as text) as engine_versions, skipped_countries, program_count, reach_count, match_count, safety_count, needs_improvement_count, cast(programs as text) as programs, cast(portfolio as text) as portfolio, cast(gaps as text) as gaps, cast(hints as text) as hints, cast(notices as text) as notices, cast(sub_scores as text) as sub_scores, computed_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from abr_assessment_result where assessment_id = #{assessmentId}
mapper.insert: insert into abr_assessment_result (assessment_id, mode, engine_versions, skipped_countries, program_count, reach_count, match_count, safety_count, needs_improvement_count, programs, portfolio, gaps, hints, notices, sub_scores, computed_time, create_by, create_time) values (#{assessmentId}, #{mode}, cast(#{engineVersions} as jsonb), coalesce(#{skippedCountries}, ''), #{programCount}, #{reachCount}, #{matchCount}, #{safetyCount}, #{needsImprovementCount}, cast(#{programs} as jsonb), cast(#{portfolio} as jsonb), cast(#{gaps} as jsonb), cast(#{hints} as jsonb), cast(#{notices} as jsonb), cast(#{subScores} as jsonb), now(), #{createBy}, now()) on conflict (assessment_id) do update set mode = excluded.mode, engine_versions = excluded.engine_versions, skipped_countries = excluded.skipped_countries, program_count = excluded.program_count, reach_count = excluded.reach_count, match_count = excluded.match_count, safety_count = excluded.safety_count, needs_improvement_count = excluded.needs_improvement_count, programs = excluded.programs, portfolio = excluded.portfolio, gaps = excluded.gaps, hints = excluded.hints, notices = excluded.notices, sub_scores = excluded.sub_scores, computed_time = now(), update_by = #{createBy}, update_time = now()
